status: post-hoc extension specified before new comparison outcomes
length: len(stored completion token_ids), including all stored special/stop tokens
calibration: single global coefficient matching total learned penalty on incorrect members of mixed groups
rank_ties: average ranks for exact stored-value ties; no rounding
rank_primary: unweighted per-prompt Spearman among incorrect rollouts, at least 2, both variables nonconstant
rank_sensitivity: same summary restricted to at least 3 incorrect rollouts
cap_exclusion: exclude whole groups with confirmed length termination or verified cap-reaching; retain original global coefficient
rounding: ROUND_HALF_UP from decimal string for display; unrounded float64 outputs retained
